selection.candidate_pool: Every finite-pose frame in the same rescan satisfying the frozen motion bounds; no target visibility, target geometry, RGB, proposal, mask, identity, or score access.
selection.score: Translation baseline multiplied by the geometric mean of bidirectional depth-consistent whole-frame visible fractions.
selection.tie_break: Higher mutual covisibility, then larger translation, then smaller frame index.
selection.truth_role: After selection only, attach target geometry to determine whether the selected frame can evaluate target-region recovery.

literature_motivation.name: Boundary Exploration of Next Best View Policy in 3D Robotic Scanning
literature_motivation.use: Motivates treating view overlap as an explicit stability constraint rather than maximizing viewpoint change alone.

literature_motivation.name: VIN-NBV
literature_motivation.use: Motivates greedy query-view scoring from existing RGB-D geometry before acquiring the candidate image.

next_action: Run the unchanged GroundingDINO-SAM2-3D-track candidate ranking on the selected action cohort and compare fixed Top-3 region coverage with the zero-covisibility action.
fallback_action: Seal source-not-evaluable without opening selected RGB; a later protocol may add target-conditioned occupancy, but may not tune motion bounds on row 3.
claim_boundary: This consumed-family Development experiment evaluates only whether a truth-free pose/depth selector can replace a zero-covisibility action with a target-evaluable view. It does not confirm generalization, identify target ownership, or establish portal access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability, or safety.
